description.en: The Fazenda re-created in the map editor: two trench lines across pasture, cane on the west flank, corn under the casa-sede.
description.pt-BR: A Fazenda refeita no editor de mapas: duas linhas de trincheira no pasto, cana no flanco oeste, milho sob a casa-sede.

setting.sourceNote: The Paraná front of 1924-1925 was held from dug-in lines (macaulay-1974, ch. III, pp. 71, 82, 85); coffee and cane fazendas of the São Paulo interior (historical note).
